definitions.explanation: An electrical appliance that removes excess moisture from the air, commonly used during the humid rainy season (tsuyu) and summer months in Japan to prevent mold and mildew.

examples.japanese: ⟦{梅雨|つゆ}→梅雨：02232_tsuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{除湿機|じょしつき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: A dehumidifier is essential during the rainy season.

examples.japanese: {除湿機|じょしつき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦カビ→カビ：07055_kabi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧。
examples.english: I use a dehumidifier to prevent mold.

examples.japanese: {除湿機|じょしつき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦タンク→タンク：23095_tanku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たまった→たまる：02067_tamaru⟧。
examples.english: Water collected in the dehumidifier's tank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋干|へやほ}し→部屋干し：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洗濯物|せんたくもの}→洗濯物：09533_sentakumono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かす→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{除湿機|じょしつき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: A dehumidifier is useful for drying laundry hung indoors.

examples.japanese: {除湿機|じょしつき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけたら→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦さらっと→さらっと：29024_saratto⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{快適|かいてき}→快適：00140_kaiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After turning on the dehumidifier, the air in the room became dry and comfortable.

notes:
COMPOSITION: {除湿|じょしつ} (dehumidification) + {機|き} (machine)
・{除|じょ} - to remove
・{湿|しつ} - moisture, humidity
・{機|き} - machine

NOTE ON CHARACTERS: Uses {機|き} (machine) rather than {器|き} (device), as dehumidifiers are typically larger than humidifiers.

TYPES OF DEHUMIDIFIERS:
・コンプレッサー{式|しき} - compressor type (effective in summer)
・デシカント{式|しき}/{ゼオライト{式|しき}} - desiccant type (effective in winter)
・ハイブリッド{式|しき} - hybrid type (year-round)

COMMON USES:
・カビ{対策|たいさく} - mold prevention
・{洗濯物|せんたくもの}の{乾燥|かんそう} - drying laundry
・{結露|けつろ}{防止|ぼうし} - condensation prevention

RELATED TERMS:
・{除湿|じょしつ} - dehumidification
・{湿度|しつど} - humidity
・{梅雨|つゆ} - rainy season
